meta.title: Cookie Policy - TopAICollection
meta.description: Learn about how TopAICollection uses cookies and similar technologies.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies
whatAreCookies.description: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your computer or mobile device when you visit our website. They help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and understanding how you use our site.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.intro: We use cookies for the following purposes:
howWeUse.essential: Essential Cookies: Required for the website to function properly, including authentication and security.
howWeUse.analytics: Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website.
howWeUse.preference: Preference Cookies: Remember your settings and preferences, such as language and locale.
howWeUse.marketing: Marketing Cookies: Used to deliver relevant advertisements and track campaign performance.

managing.title: Managing Cookies
managing.intro: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can choose to:
managing.beNotified: Be notified when a cookie is set
managing.deleteExisting: Delete cookies that have already been set
managing.note: Please note that blocking certain cookies may impact your experience on our website.
